name: Parish Church of Trindade
scope: The August 2024 exterior of Igreja Matriz do Divino Pai Eterno in Trindade, Goiás, with blue trim, two pointed-roof towers, clock gable, and long nave. This is the 1912 Santuário Velho overlooking the original square.

references.filename: Igreja Matriz do Divino Pai Eterno.jpg

originalReview.notes: The exact August 2024 plaza view shows the white façade, vivid blue bands, tall blue arched louvres, two steep gray tower roofs and a simple clock gable above the central entrance.

review.method: Exact published Qualla original with native first-party CC0 dedication
review.notes: Checked the two Qualla photographs first. Selected the exact 2024 Bryanlaridma first-party CC0 photograph. The 2010 photograph shows a different pre-restoration color scheme and was excluded from the represented era. No supplemental imagery was used.
